nom: celimax Dual Barrier Purifying Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: Very nice. No bad reaction or breakout. Used as first cleanse. Does not make ur skin feel tight. Plus the refill that comes with it is great!

this is so odd, but i love the way this tastes? labmuffin recommended it in a video and it's become a favorite quickly. super moisturizing for winter! personally, i run out of it too quickly because i use too much. it does require a washcloth to wash off completely if you used it to remove makeup, but it also emulsifies pretty well in water just by itself. i experienced some skin irritation while using it, but that was my fault lol. it's got a nice texture so i would just happily stand there and scrub it into my face for minutes on end. don't do that. with any cleanser.

avis.titre: Cleans my face without any issues
avis.texte: I find that I need just a small amount to take of the days grime and sunscreen, I do use more when I'm wearing makeup, but this is a very nice balm that effectively removes all traces of everything that was on my face, even removing mascara without an issue. This product does is not irritating to my skin or eyes. I found this to be worth the price as it comes with a refill.

avis.titre: Not the same as ordering from soko glam
avis.texte: Not the same as the product I ordered from soko glam. It doesn’t melt as well and feels different. Caused a reaction with my skin.
Works well and doesn’t leave my skin tight and irritated like other balms.

Amazing first cleanse! This has been the only oil cleanser that has not irritated my red and sensitive skin. It has no fragrance-which can be hard to find. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated, but not greasy or oily. I also really like the hygienic packaging. The is my second time purchasing this.

My skin is mostly dry, eczema-prone with oily nose. My skin breaks out when I am stressed, lacking sleep, and not moisturized well. I was looking for non-comedogenic balm cleanser that does not flare up my eczema because pink bioderma micellar water was irritating my healed eczema back. However, I am able to wear makeup again thanks to celimax cleansing balm. It is important to clarify that I wear rather light make-up, so I won’t be able to fully rate the makeup removing power. Gentle and safe product. 10/10

avis.titre: Good make up remover.Good make up remover.
avis.texte: This is a handy way to dispense make up remover. Once attached the head is turned and some remover balm comes out of the slots on the top. I got it for my wife. She says it works well in removing her make up. We order a lot of cosmetics made in Korea because they all tend to be top quality.

I just started using this cleansing balm this week. Took me a few goes to get the balm to come out of the grinder part (this is an operator issue, not the product, but I am sure other have probably had the same problem) You don't need much of the product to cleans the face - I rarely wear makeup so I am using it totally as a cleanser not a make up remover. Just a couple of little bits lathered up well. My face this morning after using is is feeling light and smooth and not dry like some cleansers can do to my skin. So going on first impressions and uses, this is winner for this old duck

avis.titre: water proof make up remover and skin cleanser in hand dispenser.
avis.texte: I received this item through the amazon Vine program - thank you kindly. This is a double pack (1 full one refill) of cleansing balm/waterproof make up remover for sensitive/dry skin. It is specifically made for water proof make up so has a somewhat greasy consistency to dissolve the make up. I was amazed when I used this product after I had already washed my face thoroughly and had used a water based cleanser before I used this one. On the make up remover pad right at the end of my video you can see just how much this cleanser still managed to get off my skin and out of my pores. It left my skin feeling clean and refreshed. The handy dispenser literally shaves a bit of the cleanser and pushes it out of two slots when you twist the top and you can easily swipe that off with your fingers or a make up removal pad. You can easily take it with you for easy use when travelling, on holidays or for weekends away. I highly recommend this item.
